tasks.subject: Task 3: typecheck-fail negatives (lambda-descent confirmation)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Lock the three step-specific rejections through the full pipeline — confirms carrier/affine descend into step's callback lambdas.

**Files:**
- Create: test/typecheck-fail-examples/future-step-input-twice.wok (+ .expected: FutureConsumedTwice Nothing "s")
- Create: test/typecheck-fail-examples/future-step-tail-twice.wok (+ .expected: FutureConsumedTwice Nothing "s'")
- Create: test/typecheck-fail-examples/future-step-tail-escapes.wok (+ .expected: CarrierEscape Nothing "grab")
- Golden files in test/typecheck-fail-golden/

STOP CONDITION: if tail-twice does NOT fire FutureConsumedTwice "s'", the walk does not track lambda params -> halt, revisit spec 3.4.

**Steps:** write 3 .wok negatives + goldens; run each via compiler, verify exact error matches BEFORE accept; accept goldens; confirm reperform still green; commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["test/typecheck-fail-examples/future-step-input-twice.wok", "test/typecheck-fail-examples/future-step-tail-twice.wok", "test/typecheck-fail-examples/future-step-tail-escapes.wok", "test/typecheck-fail-golden/future-step-input-twice.expected", "test/typecheck-fail-golden/future-step-tail-twice.expected", "test/typecheck-fail-golden/future-step-tail-escapes.expected"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test 2>&1 | grep -iE \"future-step|FAIL\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["input twice FutureConsumedTwice s", "tail twice FutureConsumedTwice s'", "tail escapes CarrierEscape grab", "reperform-unhandled still passes"]}
```
